usage: The word 起飛 (hei2 fei1) is commonly used as a verb meaning 'to take off' when referring to planes.
It can describe the action when an airplane leaves the ground and starts flying.
In everyday speech, people also use it metaphorically to describe something starting quickly or energetically.
The structure usually follows the subject (the plane, or even a flight) plus 起飛 to indicate the event happening.
Though mostly about airplanes, it sometimes applies to helicopters or other flying vehicles.
